mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gdpr_audit_log WHERE event_type = 'ERASURE_REQUESTED' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT pseudo.* FROM gdpr_audit_log pseudo WHERE pseudo.event_type = 'ERASURE_FINANCIAL_PSEUDONYMIZED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gdpr_audit_log conf WHERE conf.event_type = 'FINANCE_GOBD_CONFIRMED' AND conf.subject_token = pseudo.subject_token AND conf.created_at >= pseudo.created_at ) ORDER BY pseudo.created_at DESC, pseudo.id DESC
